cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Before slowing, turning or changing” and ends with “movement can be made safely”?
cards.back: Before slowing, turning or changing lanes, check that the movement can be made safely.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Use a signal to” and ends with “pedestrians your intended movement”?
cards.back: Use a signal to tell drivers, cyclists and pedestrians your intended movement.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Give the required signal at” and ends with “before the movement or turn”?
cards.back: Give the required signal at least one hundred feet before the movement or turn.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Keep a turn signal” and ends with “are ready to turn”?
cards.back: Keep a turn signal operating until you are ready to turn.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A vehicle required to have” and ends with “them to indicate a turn”?
cards.back: A vehicle required to have electric turn signals must use them to indicate a turn.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “At a stop sign, stop” and ends with “line when one is present”?
cards.back: At a stop sign, stop at the marked stop line when one is present.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “At a stop sign with” and ends with “stop nearest the intersecting roadway”?
cards.back: At a stop sign with no stop line, stop before the near-side crosswalk; if there is no crosswalk, stop nearest the intersecting roadway.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Stop when leaving an alley,” and ends with “a residential or business area”?
cards.back: Stop when leaving an alley, private drive or building in a residential or business area.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Stop when a school crossing” and ends with “flag in the stop position”?
cards.back: Stop when a school crossing guard holds the official flag in the stop position.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Stop when directed” and ends with “or control device”?
cards.back: Stop when directed by a railroad-crossing flagger or control device.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Stop when a” and ends with “to do so”?
cards.back: Stop when a construction flagger directs you to do so.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Stop whenever a” and ends with “you to stop”?
cards.back: Stop whenever a police officer directs you to stop.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A flashing red” and ends with “a complete stop”?
cards.back: A flashing red traffic light requires a complete stop.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Kansas requires a driving” and ends with “for the conditions present”?
cards.back: Kansas requires a driving speed that is reasonable for the conditions present.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Choose speed after considering road” and ends with “vehicle and your physical condition”?
cards.back: Choose speed after considering road conditions, weather, the vehicle and your physical condition.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The listed normal-condition maximums do” and ends with “reduce speed for special hazards”?
cards.back: The listed normal-condition maximums do not remove the need to reduce speed for special hazards.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Unless a different limit is” and ends with “of thirty miles per hour”?
cards.back: Unless a different limit is posted, an urban district has a maximum speed of thirty miles per hour.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Outside towns, the maximum is” and ends with “a different limit is posted”?
cards.back: Outside towns, the maximum is seventy-five miles per hour on a separated multilane highway designated and posted by the Secretary of Transportation, unless a different limit is posted.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Outside towns, a state or” and ends with “a different limit is posted”?
cards.back: Outside towns, a state or federal highway has a maximum speed of sixty-five miles per hour unless a different limit is posted.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Outside towns, a county or” and ends with “a different limit is posted”?
cards.back: Outside towns, a county or township road has a maximum speed of fifty-five miles per hour unless a different limit is posted.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A properly marked school” and ends with “maximum unless posted otherwise”?
cards.back: A properly marked school zone has a twenty-mile-per-hour maximum unless posted otherwise.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A properly marked business” and ends with “maximum unless posted otherwise”?
cards.back: A properly marked business district has a twenty-mile-per-hour maximum unless posted otherwise.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A school bus follows the” and ends with “unless school-district policy determines otherwise”?
cards.back: A school bus follows the posted speed limit unless school-district policy determines otherwise.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Driving below a posted minimum” and ends with “road, weather and traffic conditions”?
cards.back: Driving below a posted minimum is unlawful under normal road, weather and traffic conditions.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Unnecessarily slow driving that blocks” and ends with “even without a posted minimum”?
cards.back: Unnecessarily slow driving that blocks normal traffic is unlawful even without a posted minimum.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A slower speed remains permissible” and ends with “basic speed rule requires it”?
cards.back: A slower speed remains permissible when safe operation under the basic speed rule requires it.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Kansas requires” and ends with “safety restraints”?
cards.back: Kansas requires passenger-vehicle occupants to use safety restraints.
cards.memory_hook: Match protection to the occupant.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “An officer may stop a” and ends with “adult in a front seat”?
cards.back: An officer may stop a vehicle solely for seeing an unbelted adult in a front seat.
cards.memory_hook: Match protection to the occupant.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “An officer may stop a” and ends with “child in any seating position”?
cards.back: An officer may stop a vehicle solely for seeing an unrestrained child in any seating position.
cards.memory_hook: Match protection to the occupant.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The passenger-car driver must ensure” and ends with “protected by an appropriate restraint”?
cards.back: The passenger-car driver must ensure that every child in the car is properly protected by an appropriate restraint.
cards.memory_hook: Match protection to the occupant.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The cited restraint rule defines” and ends with “for fewer than ten passengers”?
cards.back: The cited restraint rule defines a passenger car as a vehicle built for fewer than ten passengers.
cards.memory_hook: Match protection to the occupant.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Children younger than four must” and ends with “federally approved child safety seat”?
cards.back: Children younger than four must ride in a federally approved child safety seat.
cards.memory_hook: Match protection to the occupant.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The handbook requires a” and ends with “aged eight or older”?
cards.back: The handbook requires a seat belt for children aged eight or older.
cards.memory_hook: Match protection to the occupant.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The handbook identifies the center” and ends with “as the safest safety-seat location”?
cards.back: The handbook identifies the center position in the rear seat as the safest safety-seat location.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Install and use a” and ends with “to its manufacturer's instructions”?
cards.back: Install and use a child safety seat according to its manufacturer's instructions.
cards.memory_hook: Match protection to the occupant.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Before turning right from a” and ends with “into the right lane early”?
cards.back: Before turning right from a divided four-lane highway, move into the right lane early.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “When turning right from a” and ends with “the cross street's right lane”?
cards.back: When turning right from a four-lane divided highway, make a tight turn into the cross street's right lane.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “For a left turn on” and ends with “the center line or divider”?
cards.back: For a left turn on a multilane road, begin in the inside lane near the center line or divider.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “When turning left from a” and ends with “center line without swinging wide”?
cards.back: When turning left from a multilane road, enter just right of the cross street's center line without swinging wide.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Signs or pavement” and ends with “from multiple lanes”?
cards.back: Signs or pavement arrows may authorize turns from multiple lanes.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Do not make a” and ends with “or near a hilltop”?
cards.back: Do not make a U-turn on a curve or near a hilltop.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A U-turn is prohibited where” and ends with “least five hundred feet away”?
cards.back: A U-turn is prohibited where other drivers cannot see your vehicle from at least five hundred feet away.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Follow local” and ends with “controlling U-turns”?
cards.back: Follow local ordinances and regulatory signs controlling U-turns.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A left-turning” and ends with “oncoming traffic”?
cards.back: A left-turning driver yields to oncoming traffic.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “When a left-turning vehicle and” and ends with “the straight-moving vehicle has priority”?
cards.back: When a left-turning vehicle and a straight-moving vehicle enter together, the straight-moving vehicle has priority.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “On a two-way road with” and ends with “compliance with the speed limit”?
cards.back: On a two-way road with two lanes, a left-side pass requires a safe gap and compliance with the speed limit.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Before passing, check ahead for” and ends with “another driver beginning to pass”?
cards.back: Before passing, check ahead for room and behind for another driver beginning to pass.
cards.memory_hook: Check the view before moving.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Use the left-turn signal” and ends with “pass on the left”?
cards.back: Use the left-turn signal before beginning a pass on the left.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “After passing, signal” and ends with “your normal lane”?
cards.back: After passing, signal right before returning to your normal lane.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Return right after a pass” and ends with “appears in your inside mirror”?
cards.back: Return right after a pass only when the entire front of the passed vehicle appears in your inside mirror.
cards.memory_hook: Check the view before moving.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “When another vehicle passes” and ends with “your lane without accelerating”?
cards.back: When another vehicle passes you, stay in your lane without accelerating.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Do not” and ends with “forbids it”?
cards.back: Do not pass where a sign forbids it.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The pennant-shaped warning sign marks” and ends with “area from the left roadside”?
cards.back: The pennant-shaped warning sign marks the start of a no-passing area from the left roadside.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Double solid yellow center lines” and ends with “either direction from crossing them”?
cards.back: Double solid yellow center lines prohibit traffic from either direction from crossing them.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Finish a pass and return” and ends with “is within two hundred feet”?
cards.back: Finish a pass and return to your lane before an oncoming vehicle is within two hundred feet.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The handbook identifies the no-passing” and ends with “the only pennant-shaped warning sign”?
cards.back: The handbook identifies the no-passing warning sign as the only pennant-shaped warning sign.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Passing on the right is” and ends with “traveling in the same direction”?
cards.back: Passing on the right is permitted on a one-way road marked with at least two lanes traveling in the same direction.
cards.memory_hook: Keep the licensing path distinct.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Do not use the shoulder” and ends with “or instructions from traffic authorities”?
cards.back: Do not use the shoulder to pass except for an emergency or instructions from traffic authorities.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Check ahead and behind” and ends with “passing on the right”?
cards.back: Check ahead and behind and signal before passing on the right.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Following distance must be” and ends with “roadway and traffic conditions”?
cards.back: Following distance must be reasonable for weather, roadway and traffic conditions.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Leave enough following space to” and ends with “the vehicle ahead stops abruptly”?
cards.back: Leave enough following space to stop or turn if the vehicle ahead stops abruptly.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The handbook uses” and ends with “for ideal conditions”?
cards.back: The handbook uses a two-second following interval for ideal conditions.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The handbook uses a” and ends with “when conditions are adverse”?
cards.back: The handbook uses a four-second following interval when conditions are adverse.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Increase the following gap behind” and ends with “stop frequently or turn abruptly”?
cards.back: Increase the following gap behind vehicles likely to stop frequently or turn abruptly.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Poor weather calls” and ends with “greater following gap”?
cards.back: Poor weather calls for an even greater following gap.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Following too closely limits” and ends with “and road conditions ahead”?
cards.back: Following too closely limits the view of traffic and road conditions ahead.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

decks.module: Buses, emergency vehicles and road workers

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “For an approaching emergency vehicle” and ends with “and stop clear of intersections”?
cards.back: For an approaching emergency vehicle using flashing red lights or a siren, pull right and stop clear of intersections.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Unless on the opposing roadway” and ends with “or unload children must stop”?
cards.back: Unless on the opposing roadway of a divided highway, a driver meeting or overtaking a school, church or day-care bus stopped to load or unload children must stop.
cards.memory_hook: Match protection to the occupant.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “After stopping for a school,” and ends with “and red lights turn off”?
cards.back: After stopping for a school, church or day-care bus loading or unloading children, remain stopped until its stop signal retracts and red lights turn off.
cards.memory_hook: Match protection to the occupant.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Traffic on the opposing roadway” and ends with “bus loading or unloading children”?
cards.back: Traffic on the opposing roadway of a divided highway need not stop for a school bus loading or unloading children.
cards.memory_hook: Match protection to the occupant.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “An emergency vehicle using a” and ends with “siren or bell has priority”?
cards.back: An emergency vehicle using a forward red light or a siren or bell has priority.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “For an emergency vehicle using” and ends with “stopped until it has passed”?
cards.back: For an emergency vehicle using a forward red light, siren or bell, pull right and remain stopped until it has passed.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Do not follow” and ends with “with warning signals”?
cards.back: Do not follow an emergency vehicle responding with warning signals.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “When approaching a stopped emergency” and ends with “a lane change is possible”?
cards.back: When approaching a stopped emergency vehicle using flashing warning lights from behind on a road with at least two lanes in each direction, cautiously move out of its adjacent lane if a lane change is possible.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “If a lane change is” and ends with “slow down and proceed cautiously”?
cards.back: If a lane change is impossible when approaching from behind a stopped emergency vehicle using flashing warning lights on a road with at least two lanes each way, slow down and proceed cautiously.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Yield to construction workers” and ends with “working on the road”?
cards.back: Yield to construction workers and vehicles actively working on the road.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Move to a lane away” and ends with “vehicle working on the roadway”?
cards.back: Move to a lane away from a construction vehicle working on the roadway.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

decks.module: Intersection priority and available exit space

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Yield to a vehicle that” and ends with “the intersection from another road”?
cards.back: Yield to a vehicle that has already entered the intersection from another road.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “When vehicles enter an intersection” and ends with “the driver on the right”?
cards.back: When vehicles enter an intersection from different roadways at about the same time, the driver on the left yields to the driver on the right.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “At an uncontrolled intersection,” and ends with “vehicle on your right”?
cards.back: At an uncontrolled intersection, yield to the vehicle on your right.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “At a stop-controlled entrance to” and ends with “only without interfering with traffic”?
cards.back: At a stop-controlled entrance to a through road, stop and enter only without interfering with traffic.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A vehicle entering from a” and ends with “traffic on the public roadway”?
cards.back: A vehicle entering from a private drive or side road yields to traffic on the public roadway.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Before crossing the sidewalk from” and ends with “district, stop and then yield”?
cards.back: Before crossing the sidewalk from an alley, driveway or building in a business or residential district, stop and then yield.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “At a yield sign, stop” and ends with “with priority traffic or pedestrians”?
cards.back: At a yield sign, stop only when needed to avoid interfering with priority traffic or pedestrians.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Do not enter an intersection,” and ends with “beyond it for your vehicle”?
cards.back: Do not enter an intersection, crosswalk or railroad crossing without space beyond it for your vehicle.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A green signal does not” and ends with “that lacks room beyond it”?
cards.back: A green signal does not permit entering an intersection that lacks room beyond it.
cards.memory_hook: Keep the licensing path distinct.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Parking inside” and ends with “is prohibited”?
cards.back: Parking inside an intersection is prohibited.
cards.memory_hook: Keep location with its parking rule.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Parking in” and ends with “is prohibited”?
cards.back: Parking in an intersection crosswalk is prohibited.
cards.memory_hook: Keep location with its parking rule.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Do not park” and ends with “a fire hydrant”?
cards.back: Do not park within fifteen feet of a fire hydrant.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Do not park with the” and ends with “twelve inches from the curb”?
cards.back: Do not park with the vehicle more than twelve inches from the curb.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Parking in” and ends with “is prohibited”?
cards.back: Parking in front of a driveway is prohibited.
cards.memory_hook: Keep location with its parking rule.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Parking on a” and ends with “structure is prohibited”?
cards.back: Parking on a highway bridge or elevated structure is prohibited.
cards.memory_hook: Keep location with its parking rule.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Parking inside” and ends with “is prohibited”?
cards.back: Parking inside a tunnel is prohibited.
cards.memory_hook: Keep location with its parking rule.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Do not” and ends with “prohibit parking”?
cards.back: Do not park where official signs prohibit parking.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Double parking along” and ends with “roadside is prohibited”?
cards.back: Double parking along the curb or roadside is prohibited.
cards.memory_hook: Keep location with its parking rule.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Do not park on a” and ends with “vehicle would obstruct ordinary traffic”?
cards.back: Do not park on a narrow road where the vehicle would obstruct ordinary traffic.
cards.memory_hook: Keep location with its parking rule.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Parking on” and ends with “is prohibited”?
cards.back: Parking on a sidewalk is prohibited.
cards.memory_hook: Keep location with its parking rule.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Do not park within the” and ends with “stop sign or flashing beacon”?
cards.back: Do not park within the thirty-foot approach to a roadside signal, stop sign or flashing beacon.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Do not park between” and ends with “and the nearby curb”?
cards.back: Do not park between a safety zone and the nearby curb.
cards.memory_hook: Keep location with its parking rule.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Do not park within thirty” and ends with “ends of a safety zone”?
cards.back: Do not park within thirty feet of the curb points opposite the ends of a safety zone.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Keep parked vehicles at” and ends with “the nearest railroad-crossing rail”?
cards.back: Keep parked vehicles at least fifty feet from the nearest railroad-crossing rail.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Do not park within” and ends with “a fire-station driveway entrance”?
cards.back: Do not park within twenty feet of a fire-station driveway entrance.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “On the opposite side of” and ends with “prohibits parking within seventy-five feet”?
cards.back: On the opposite side of a fire-station entrance, the handbook prohibits parking within seventy-five feet.
cards.memory_hook: Match the space to conditions.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Do not park beside or” and ends with “doing so would block traffic”?
cards.back: Do not park beside or opposite roadwork or another obstruction when doing so would block traffic.
cards.memory_hook: Keep location with its parking rule.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The handbook lists” and ends with “restricted parking locations”?
cards.back: The handbook lists designated disability-parking spaces among restricted parking locations.
cards.memory_hook: Read the control and its condition.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Kansas prohibits composing, sending” and ends with “electronic communication while driving”?
cards.back: Kansas prohibits composing, sending or reading written electronic communication while driving.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The written-communication” and ends with “and email”?
cards.back: The written-communication restriction includes text messages and email.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “The handbook excludes GPS” and ends with “from its written-communication prohibition”?
cards.back: The handbook excludes GPS use and weather reports from its written-communication prohibition.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Talking or dialing on a” and ends with “rule described in this section”?
cards.back: Talking or dialing on a cell phone is not specifically prohibited by the general rule described in this section.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “A distracting activity remains” and ends with “is not specifically prohibited”?
cards.back: A distracting activity remains dangerous even when it is not specifically prohibited.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Move out” and ends with “driver's way”?
cards.back: Move out of an aggressive driver's way.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Do not provoke an aggressive” and ends with “defending your place in traffic”?
cards.back: Do not provoke an aggressive driver by accelerating or defending your place in traffic.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Avoid eye contact” and ends with “an aggressive driver”?
cards.back: Avoid eye contact that could further anger an aggressive driver.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.

cards.front: What complete rule starts with “Ignore hostile gestures” and ends with “responding in kind”?
cards.back: Ignore hostile gestures or insults without responding in kind.
cards.memory_hook: Keep this condition with its action.
